item.title: SIGNED | Davis Keillor-Dunn returns to Wrexham
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to confirm the signing of Davis Keillor-Dunn from League One side Barnsley for an undisclosed fee. The 28-year-old striker has signed a contract until the end of the 2028/29 season. A former Red Dragon, Keillor-Dunn returns to the Club where he made three starts and three substitute appearances, and scored one memorable goal against Bromley in the 2019/20 season. item.title: LOANED OUT | Harry Ashfield joins Cheltenham Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm midfielder Harry Ashfield has completed a loan move to Cheltenham Town until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. A lifelong Wrexham fan, Ashfield has been with the club since 2015, making his first-team debut in our 3-0 EFL Trophy victory over Crewe Alexandra in 2023. Steve Cotterill’s Cheltenham side currently sit 18th in League Two with 30 points from 28 games. item.title: LOANED OUT | Ryan Hardie joins Huddersfield Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm Ryan Hardie has completed a loan move to Huddersfield Town until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. The 28-year-old Scottish striker has made 10 appearances in all competitions for Wrexham this season, netting one goal in the EFL Cup against Preston North End. The Terriers currently sit in the play-off places in League One, following three straight victories against Bradford, Luton and Peterborough. item.title: LOANED OUT | Mo Faal joins Cheltenham Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm striker Mo Faal has completed a loan move to Cheltenham Town for the remainder of the 2025/26 campaign. Faal arrived in North Wales in summer 2024, as a graduate of West Bromwich Albion’s academy, scoring three goals in his debut season. He started the current campaign on loan at Port Vale but returned last month after injury, and will now complete the season with Steve Cotterill’s Cheltenham Town. item.title: HOSPITALITY | Secure your place for Ipswich Town FA Cup fixture
item.description: Limited Hospitality Tickets are still available for our Emirates FA Cup Fourth Round match at home to Ipswich Town on Friday, February 13, as the Red Dragons look to secure a place in the next round at the SToK Cae Ras. Phil Parkinson's side secured victory over Premier League side Nottingham Forest in a dramatic penalty shoot-out which set up a tie with the Tractor Boys. All hospitality packages are available via our eTicketing site. Please note, hospitality is only available to HOME supporters
